```{r setup}
# Reads only the scored results in data/ (no Stan fits); renders in seconds.
# Render from the compendium root: quarto render manuscript/reproduce.qmd
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

This document redraws Figures 3 to 7 of the manuscript and recomputes every
result that the text reports, from the scored outputs of the scripts in
`analysis/`. Each number is shown as the text gives it next to the value
computed here, and the document **fails to render** if any of them disagree,
so that the text and the data cannot drift apart. Figures 1 and 2 are schematic
(`R/fig_dag_v2.R` and `manuscript/figures/make_scheme_fig2.py`).

```{r data}
main <- readRDS("data/fp_sim_summary.rds")
main_reps <- readRDS("data/fp_sim_results.rds")
fix  <- readRDS("data/fp_fix_summary.rds")
fix_reps <- readRDS("data/fp_fix_results.rds")
pc   <- readRDS("data/fp_positive_control_summary.rds")
pc_reps <- readRDS("data/fp_positive_control_results.rds")
int  <- readRDS("data/fp_intensity_summary.rds")
int_reps <- readRDS("data/fp_intensity_results.rds")
rev  <- readRDS("data/fp_revision_summary.rds")
nj   <- readRDS("data/nightjar_fits.rds")

# numbers as the manuscript prints them: half rounded up, a true minus sign,
# an explicit plus where the text gives one, en-dash ranges
num <- function(x, d = 2, plus = FALSE) {
  s <- formatC(round(x + sign(x) * 1e-9, d), format = "f", digits = d)
  s <- if_else(plus & round(x, d) > 0, paste0("+", s), s)
  str_replace(s, "^-", "−")
}
pct <- function(x, d = 0) num(100 * x, d)
rng <- function(x, d = 2, f = num) paste0(f(min(x), d), "–", f(max(x), d))
rng_pct <- function(x) paste0(pct(min(x)), "–", pct(max(x)), "%")

claims <- tibble(section = character(), quote = character(), text = character(),
                 computed = character(), tol = numeric())
# tol > 0 compares the numbers in text and computed within tol instead of
# requiring the same string (used for the nightjar fits, see claim_nj below)
claim <- function(section, quote, text, computed, tol = 0) {
  claims <<- add_row(claims, section = section, quote = quote, text = text,
                     computed = computed, tol = tol)
}
numbers_in <- \(s) as.numeric(str_extract_all(str_replace_all(s, "\u2212", "-"),
                                               "-?[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*")[[1]])
agree <- function(text, computed, tol) {
  if (tol == 0) return(text == computed)
  a <- numbers_in(text); b <- numbers_in(computed)
  length(a) == length(b) && all(abs(a - b) <= tol + 1e-9)
}
# regimes and the four cells shared by all of them in Figure 3
main <- main |>
  mutate(regime = case_when(conf_effect > 0 ~ "structured",
                            beta_conc > 0 ~ "unstructured", TRUE ~ "homogeneous"))
core <- \(d) filter(d, p10 %in% c(0.05, 0.20), coverage %in% c(0.1, 0.3))
mw <- rev$main_width_rmse
```

## Figure 3: the three false-positive regimes

```{r fig3, fig.width=7, fig.height=3.125}
# each script runs in its own environment, so its objects stay out of the way
run <- function(script) { e <- new.env(); source(script, local = e); e }
figs356 <- run("analysis/14_figs_3_5_6.R")
figs356$fig3
```

```{r claims-regimes}
h <- core(filter(main, regime == "homogeneous"))
claim("Results 1", "true false-positive rate in 95%", "95",
      pct(mean(h$stan_p10_coverage95)))
claim("Results 1", "true environmental effect in 96% of replicates", "96",
      pct(mean(h$stan_b1_coverage95)))
claim("Results 1", "bias of −0.03 for the environmental effect", "−0.03",
      num(mean(h$stan_b1_bias)))
claim("Results 1", "occuFP matched it (coverage of 0.94 and 0.96)", "0.94 and 0.96",
      paste(num(mean(h$occufp_p10_coverage95)), "and", num(mean(h$occufp_b1_coverage95))))

u <- core(filter(main, regime == "unstructured"))
claim("Results 2", "the coverage of the rate itself fell to 0.00", "0.00",
      num(mean(u$stan_p10_coverage95)))
claim("Results 2", "bias of −0.08", "−0.08",
      num(mean(u$stan_p10_bias)))
claim("Results 2", "with a coverage of 0.81", "0.81", num(mean(u$stan_b1_coverage95)))
claim("Results 2", "0.91–0.92 at the lower", "0.91–0.92",
      rng(u$stan_b1_coverage95[u$p10 == 0.05]))
claim("Results 2", "0.65–0.74 at the higher false-positive rate", "0.65–0.74",
      rng(u$stan_b1_coverage95[u$p10 == 0.20]))

s <- core(filter(main, regime == "structured"))
claim("Results 3", "coverage of the false-positive rate fell to 0.04", "0.04",
      num(mean(s$stan_p10_coverage95)))
claim("Results 3", "that of the environmental effect to 0.05", "0.05",
      num(mean(s$stan_b1_coverage95)))
s10 <- filter(s, coverage == 0.1)
claim("Results 3", "at the lower rate it was +0.43 (10% of sites verified)", "+0.43",
      num(s10$stan_b1_bias[s10$p10 == 0.05], plus = TRUE))
claim("Results 3", "estimated near −0.37", "−0.37",
      num(-0.8 + s10$stan_b1_bias[s10$p10 == 0.05]))
claim("Results 3", "at the higher rate it reached +0.91", "+0.91",
      num(s10$stan_b1_bias[s10$p10 == 0.20], plus = TRUE))
claim("Results 3", "crossed zero to +0.11", "+0.11",
      num(-0.8 + s10$stan_b1_bias[s10$p10 == 0.20], plus = TRUE))
claim("Results 3", "mean width 0.50–0.53", "0.50–0.53",
      rng(mw$stan.width[mw$regime == "structured"]))
claim("Results 3", "against 0.55–0.59", "0.55–0.59",
      rng(mw$stan.width[mw$regime == "homogeneous"]))
claim("Results 3", "root mean squared error ... rose from 0.14–0.17", "0.14–0.17",
      rng(mw$stan.rmse[mw$regime == "homogeneous"]))
claim("Results 3", "to 0.40–0.92", "0.40–0.92",
      rng(mw$stan.rmse[mw$regime == "structured"]))

claim("Results 9", "coverage of the environmental effect was 0.76 under unstructured heterogeneity",
      "0.76", num(mean(u$occufp_b1_coverage95)))
claim("Results 9", "and 0.04 under structured confusion", "0.04",
      num(mean(s$occufp_b1_coverage95)))
claim("Results 9", "biased by about the same amount (−0.08)", "−0.08",
      num(mean(u$occufp_p10_bias)))
claim("Results 9", "covered the false-positive rate in 2% of replicates", "2",
      pct(mean(u$occufp_p10_coverage95)))
```

```{r claims-intensity}
weak <- filter(int, conf_effect <= 0.5)
at <- \(e, r, col) int[[col]][int$conf_effect == e & int$conf_cor == r]
claim("Results 7", "contained the true value in 94–96% of replicates", "94–96%",
      rng_pct(weak$stan_b1_coverage95))
claim("Results 7", "absolute bias no larger than 0.012", "0.012",
      num(max(abs(weak$stan_b1_bias)), 3))
claim("Results 7", "at an effect of 1.0, coverage fell from 0.92 to 0.76 and 0.63", "0.92, 0.76, 0.63",
      paste(num(map_dbl(c(0.3, 0.7, 1), \(r) at(1, r, "stan_b1_coverage95"))), collapse = ", "))
claim("Results 7", "at an effect of 1.5 it fell from 0.68 to 0.13 and 0.02", "0.68, 0.13, 0.02",
      paste(num(map_dbl(c(0.3, 0.7, 1), \(r) at(1.5, r, "stan_b1_coverage95"))), collapse = ", "))
claim("Results 7", "with the bias reaching +0.60", "+0.60",
      num(max(int$stan_b1_bias), plus = TRUE))
claim("Results 7", "occuFP: coverage of 0.94–0.96 under weak confusion", "0.94–0.96",
```

## Costs of the remedies and their detection

```{r claims-checks}
fits <- rev$fits
hom <- filter(fits, regime == "homogeneous")
claim("Results 10", "that model covered the environmental effect in 91–98% of replicates", "91–98%",
      rng_pct(hom$slope.coverage[hom$model == "fp_x"]))
claim("Results 10", "against 89–97% for the constant-rate model", "89–97%",
      rng_pct(hom$slope.coverage[hom$model == "constant"]))
det <- rev$detection
claim("Results 10", "preferred that model by more than four units of ELPD in 94–100% of replicates",
      "94–100%", rng_pct(det$loo_prefers_fp_x_4[det$regime == "structured"]))
claim("Results 10", "against at most 1% with homogeneous false positives", "1",
      pct(max(det$loo_prefers_fp_x_4[det$regime == "homogeneous"])))

# observation confirmation: share of the bias of the naive model removed
oc <- rev$obsconfirm_clare
red <- oc |>
  select(conf_effect, p10, frac_confirmed, model, slope.bias, slope.coverage) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(slope.bias, slope.coverage)) |>
  # capped at 100%: one cell overshoots to a bias of -0.012 (MCSE 0.014),
  # which the text counts as all of the bias removed
  mutate(removed = pmin(1, 1 - slope.bias_constant / slope.bias_naive))
claim("Results 10", "removed 47–100% of the bias of a model that ignored false positives",
      "47–100%", rng_pct(red$removed))
o7 <- filter(rev$obsconfirm, regime == "structured", model == "constant", frac_confirmed == 0.3) |>
  arrange(p10)
claim("Results 10", "checking 30% of occasions raised its coverage only to 0.61 and 0.18",
      "0.61 and 0.18", paste(num(o7$slope.coverage), collapse = " and "))
claim("Results 10", "covered the environmental effect in 92–98% of replicates at cor(w, x) = 1.0",
      "92–98%", rng_pct(oc$slope.coverage[oc$model == "fp_x"]))
low <- filter(red, removed < 0.75)
claim("Discussion 2", "in the cells where the correction removed 47–74% of the bias", "47–74%",
      rng_pct(low$removed))
claim("Discussion 2", "its 95% interval contained the true value in at most 4% of replicates", "4",
      pct(max(low$slope.coverage_constant)))
```

## Figure 7: the nightjar data

```{r fig7, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=3.6}
run("analysis/16_fig7_nightjar.R")$fig7
```

```{r claims-nightjar}
tab <- map_dfr(nj$fits, \(f) mutate(f$table, fp = f$fp, threshold = f$threshold))
get <- \(v, th, fp = "~ 1") filter(tab, variable == v, threshold == th, .data$fp == !!fp)
ci <- \(r) paste0(num(r$mean), " (", num(r$lower), " to ", num(r$upper), ")")
# repeated runs of 15_nightjar.R with the same seed differ slightly (the
# likelihood is summed in parallel within each chain), by up to 0.01 in these
# estimates, so the nightjar estimates are checked within that tolerance; the
# diagnostics describe the stored fits and are checked exactly
claim_nj <- \(...) claim(..., tol = 0.01)
# classifier scores of the curiango data, from crywolf (installed for 15_nightjar.R)
conf <- local({ e <- new.env(); data("curiango", package = "crywolf", envir = e,
                 lib.loc = c(".lib-crywolf-1.9.0", .libPaths())); e$curiango$minutes$conf_custom })
claim("Results 11", "fell from 6.8% at a threshold of 0.2 to 0.6% at 0.8", "6.8% to 0.6%",
      paste0(pct(mean(conf >= 0.2), 1), "% to ", pct(mean(conf >= 0.8), 1), "%"))
claim_nj("Results 11", "mean false-positive rate per recording fell from 2.60% to 0.06%", "2.60% to 0.06%",
      paste0(pct(get("p10_bar", 0.2)$mean, 2), "% to ", pct(get("p10_bar", 0.8)$mean, 2), "%"))
claim_nj("Results 11", "temperature effect changed sign, to 0.16 (95% credible interval 0.05 to 0.28)",
      "0.16 (0.05 to 0.28)", ci(get("occ_temp", 0.2)))
claim_nj("Results 11", "intercept of the verified process ... fell from 0.94 (0.70 to 1.20) at 0.4",
      "0.94 (0.70 to 1.20)", ci(get("verified_(Intercept)", 0.4)))
claim_nj("Results 11", "to 0.14 (−0.05 to 0.34)", "0.14 (−0.05 to 0.34)",
      ci(get("verified_(Intercept)", 0.2)))
claim_nj("Results 12", "false positives ... rose with temperature (0.27 on the logit scale, 0.21 to 0.34)",
      "0.27 (0.21 to 0.34)", ci(get("fp_temp", 0.2, "~ temp + rh")))
claim_nj("Results 12", "temperature effect on nightly use shrank from 0.16 to 0.09", "0.09",
      num(get("occ_temp", 0.2, "~ temp + rh")$mean))
claim_nj("Results 12", "the false-positive rate fell with humidity (−0.38, −0.49 to −0.26)",
      "−0.38 (−0.49 to −0.26)", ci(get("fp_rh", 0.4, "~ temp + rh")))
dg <- map_dfr(nj$fits, \(f) as_tibble(f$diagnostics[c("max_rhat", "divergences")]))
claim("Results 12", "potential scale reduction factor at or below 1.011", "1.011",
      num(max(dg$max_rhat), 3))
claim("Results 12", "with no divergent transitions", "0", as.character(sum(dg$divergences)))
```

## Sampling behaviour

```{r claims-sampling}
arms <- bind_rows(
  transmute(fix_reps, rhat = fixstan_max_rhat, ndiv = fixstan_ndiv),
  transmute(pc_reps, rhat = fpcov_max_rhat, ndiv = fpcov_ndiv),
  transmute(int_reps, rhat = stan_max_rhat, ndiv = stan_ndiv))
claim("Results 13", "The 4,300 fits of the main design", "4,300",
      format(nrow(main_reps), big.mark = ","))
claim("Results 13", "had a single divergent transition", "1",
      as.character(sum(main_reps$stan_ndiv, na.rm = TRUE)))
claim("Results 13", "at or below 1.008", "1.008", num(max(main_reps$stan_max_rhat, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
claim("Results 13", "the 4,400 fits of the covariate-dependent arms and of the intensity block",
      "4,400", format(nrow(arms), big.mark = ","))
claim("Results 13", "had none", "0", as.character(sum(arms$ndiv, na.rm = TRUE)))
claim("Results 13", "above 1.01 in only four fits", "4",
      as.character(sum(arms$rhat > 1.01, na.rm = TRUE)))
claim("Results 13", "(maximum 1.019)", "1.019", num(max(arms$rhat, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
```

## Every number, text against data

```{r check}
claims <- mutate(claims, ok = pmap_lgl(list(text, computed, tol), agree))
knitr::kable(select(claims, section, quote, text, computed, ok),
             col.names = c("Section", "Sentence in the manuscript", "Text", "Computed", "Match"))
bad <- filter(claims, !ok)
# with strict: false (quarto render ... -P strict:false) the mismatches are
# reported in the table instead of stopping the render
if (nrow(bad) > 0 && isTRUE(params$strict))
  stop(nrow(bad), " number(s) in the manuscript disagree with the data:\n",
       paste0("  ", bad$section, ": ", bad$quote, " [text ", bad$text,
              ", computed ", bad$computed, "]", collapse = "\n"))
```

`r if (nrow(bad) == 0) paste("All", nrow(claims), "numbers agree with the data.") else paste0("**", nrow(bad), " of ", nrow(claims), " numbers disagree with the data** (rows marked FALSE above).")`
